info.title: Vision Drafting API
info.description: CRUD for drafts + agent tools for draft orchestration.

GET /api/cases/{case_id}/drafts.description: List all drafts for a case
GET /api/cases/{case_id}/drafts.notes: Omits content column — use GET /drafts/{id} for full content

GET /api/drafts/{draft_id}.description: Get a single draft with full block content

content.content: Vision Technologies, LLC is a Maryland-based...

Ian Bruce
Principal, Vision Technologies, LLC

PATCH /api/drafts/{draft_id}.description: Update draft metadata or content (user edits)
PATCH /api/drafts/{draft_id}.notes: All fields optional. Only provided fields are updated. If content is provided, it replaces the full block array. For single-block updates, use PATCH /api/drafts/{id}/blocks/{block_id}.

PATCH /api/drafts/{draft_id}/blocks/{blo.description: Update a single block within a draft

agent_tools.description: Registered on the vision MCP server via create_vision_server() factory. Closure-scoped to case_id.

create_draft.description: Create a new draft with structured blocks

parameters.name: string (required) — Display title
parameters.document_type: string (required) — letter | pleading | contract | memo | other
parameters.content: array of blocks (required) — each with {id, type, content}

update_draft.description: Modify specific blocks or metadata in an existing draft

parameters.name: string (optional)
parameters.content: array of blocks (optional) — replaces entire content

replace_draft.description: Replace entire draft content — use when rewriting a draft from scratch

parameters.content: array of blocks (required) — the new full block array

list_drafts.description: List existing drafts for the current case
list_drafts.returns: { count, drafts: [{ id, name, document_type, status, block_count, updated_at }] }

get_draft.description: Read a draft's full content — use before editing
get_draft.returns: { draft: { id, name, document_type, status, content, ... } }
